name: Harem★Island ~Otoko<Onna 7nin Natsu Monogatari Theme Park wa Oosawagi~
original_name: ハーレム★アイランド～男＜女7人夏物語テーマパークは大騒ぎ～
source:
Masayuki Shimada works part time at a major theme park that’s situated on a deserted island. While working there he does several odd jobs that have him meeting his fellow workers on the island. Of his co-workers there happens to be six lovely women. Being a fantasy-themed park, they all cosplay as various characters to further add fuel to his lusting. In a tactful (but probably unintentional) manner, he begins courting all the women and begins his own personal harem at the park.

[From White Masq]
translation:
岛田正幸在一座位于无人岛上的大型主题公园打工。工作期间，他负责各种杂务，也因此结识了岛上的同事。其中有六位漂亮的女性同事。由于这是以幻想为主题的公园，她们还会分别扮演各种角色，为他的欲望火上浇油。他以一种圆滑（不过很可能并非有意）的方式，开始同时追求所有女性，在公园里建立起属于自己的后宫。

[摘自White Masq]
